evidence: Three hooks in src/hooks/ — all CommonJS (package.json sets type: commonjs to prevent ESM/CJS conflict). SessionStart (wabblespec-session-start.js): runs once per session open; writes session flag to ~/.claude/.wabblespec-session; emits invariant context and active task state as stdout injected as system prompt addendum. UserPromptSubmit (wabblespec-prompt-guard.js): runs before every user prompt; two informational nudges only (wave progress if active session with completed waves; recipe reminder if no active session and prompt looks task-start-like); never blocks. Statusline (wabblespec-statusline.ps1): reads flag file, outputs [WS idle] or [WS task-id w:N/M]. Flag file channel (~/.claude/.wabblespec-session): atomic temp+rename write, mode 0600, refuses symlinks. Silent-fail contract: all hooks catch errors and emit {} rather than non-zero exit.
